claim: The KV-Event Processing pool config exposes a documented 'Static Endpoint Mode' (discoverPods: false, zmqEndpoint set) that requires no Kubernetes API access at all: the indexer binds a local ZMQ socket and any process (Kubernetes or not) that publishes a matching 'kv@'-prefixed topic can connect to it as a PUB client.
stance_target: feasibility of supporting non-Kubernetes backends without modifying the KV-cache indexer
scope_conditions: llm-d-kv-cache library, main branch, commit a746476 (May 2026)
quoted_support: 1. Static Endpoint Mode: Connects to a single ZMQ endpoint ... The zmqEndpoint field specifies the local ZMQ socket address to bind to.

claim: Auto-Discovery Mode (default, discoverPods: true) is implemented as a Kubernetes pod reconciler that watches pods and requires all of: label-selector match, pod.Status.Phase == Running, pod.Status.PodIP != '', and PodReady == ConditionTrue before creating a ZMQ subscriber, tearing it down automatically if any condition becomes false.
stance_target: exact scope of the Kubernetes coupling in the KV-cache indexer's pod-discovery path
quoted_support: For the reconciler to create a subscriber for a pod, the pod must meet these conditions: 1. Match label selector... 2. Running state: pod.Status.Phase == Running 3. Has IP address: pod.Status.PodIP != "" 4. Ready condition: Pod has condition PodReady == ConditionTrue

claim: Using Auto-Discovery pod-reconciler mode requires explicit RBAC grants (get/list/watch on the 'pods' resource) scoped either per-namespace or cluster-wide depending on whether podNamespace is set.
stance_target: operational cost of the Kubernetes-coupled discovery path
quoted_support: When using the pod reconciler, ensure the service account has appropriate RBAC permissions... resources: ["pods"] verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]

claim: The KV-event pool's engineType field ('vllm' or 'sglang', default 'vllm') selects which EngineAdapter parses the wire format, confirming engine-format extensibility is a config-level adapter selection rather than a discovery-layer concern.
stance_target: extension points for supporting additional inference engines
quoted_support: engineType | string | Inference engine adapter type ("vllm" or "sglang") | "vllm"

claim: The indexer's internal request-key hashSeed is explicitly independent of vLLM's PYTHONHASHSEED and requires no alignment with any engine-side seed, because engine keys and request keys are bridged on ingestion rather than computed identically.
stance_target: hash-seed configuration independence between the indexer and the inference engine
quoted_support: The hashSeed in TokenProcessorConfig seeds the indexer's internal request-key hashing. Engine keys and request keys are decoupled -- no alignment with vLLM's PYTHONHASHSEED is required.
